plan.intervention: Execute identical model forward, detach only bank module input by pre-hook in second backward. plan.interpretation: Conditional current-weight loss gradients only. Not a cause of past drift, a claim of beneficial detached training, a quality score, or an old-study extension. No thresholds selected or target/frequency passed to model forward.
